name: Hysterectomy for Endometriosis — Oregon Prioritized List Guideline Note 39 (Section A)

branches.endometriosis: Hysterectomy indicated by documented endometriosis (Section A of Guideline Note 39). N80.03 (adenomyosis of uterus) is intentionally excluded and routes to the sibling policy oregon-hcr-39.

criteria.description: Medical necessity for hysterectomy in endometriosis. ALL of patient history, failed 3-month trial, cervical cytology, and pregnancy-status criteria must be met.

policy_citation.quote: Hysterectomy, with or without adnexectomy, for endometriosis may be appropriate when all of the following are documented

children.description: Documented patient history: prior endometriosis diagnosis AND >6 months of pain with QoL impact.
Prior operative description or histologic diagnosis of endometriosis.

policy_citation.quote: Prior detailed operative description or histologic diagnosis of endometriosis

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for prior laparoscopy / laparotomy operative report describing endometriosis implants, OR pathology report confirming endometrial glands and stroma outside the uterus, OR a documented historical diagnosis in problem list.

verdict_rubric.met: Prior operative report describes endometriosis OR pathology confirms it OR clear historical clinical diagnosis is documented.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Endometriosis is a presumptive diagnosis without prior operative/histologic confirmation.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Patient reports prior surgery without records available.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No mention of prior endometriosis diagnosis in records.

children.description: Presence of pain for more than 6 months with documented negative effect on quality of life.

policy_citation.quote: Presence of pain for more than 6 months with negative effect on patient’s quality of life

evaluation.extraction_hints: Find symptom-onset date establishing >6 months of pain plus narrative documenting ADL/QoL impact (work, sleep, intimacy, activity restriction).

verdict_rubric.met: Pain onset >6 months before request AND narrative of QoL impact present.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Pain duration <6 months OR no QoL impact described.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Duration documented but QoL impact vague, or vice versa.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No pain history in available records.

children.description: Completed 3-month trial of hormonal therapy AND NSAIDs, OR documented contraindication.

policy_citation.quote: Failure of a 3-month therapeutic trial with both of the following (a and b), unless there are contraindications to use

children.description: Completed 3-month trial of BOTH hormonal therapy AND NSAIDs.
Trial of hormonal therapy for at least 3 months. Acceptable agents: OCPs, progesterone IUDs, injectable hormone therapy, GnRH analogs, danazol.

policy_citation.quote: Hormonal therapy (i or ii): i) Oral contraceptive pills or patches, progesterone-containing IUDs, injectable hormone therapy, or similar ii) Agents for inducing amenorrhea (e.g., GnRH analogs or danazol)

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for OCPs (norethindrone, drospirenone, etc.), levonorgestrel-IUD (Mirena), DMPA, leuprolide, danazol. Validate ≥3-month duration via start/end dates.

verdict_rubric.met: Hormonal agent from listed classes documented for ≥3 months.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Hormonal trial documented but <3 months total duration.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Agent documented but dates ambiguous; class borderline (e.g., topical hormones).

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for ibuprofen, naproxen, diclofenac, meloxicam, celecoxib, ketorolac. Confirm an active or completed trial concurrent with hormonal therapy.

verdict_rubric.not_met: Pain management documented only with non-NSAID agents (e.g., acetaminophen only).
verdict_rubric.unclear: Generic 'pain reliever' mentioned without identifying class.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No NSAID or pain medication in records.

children.description: Documented clinical contraindication to hormonal therapy or NSAIDs that justifies skipping the 3-month trial.

policy_citation.quote: unless there are contraindications to use

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for AllergyIntolerance to NSAIDs or hormonal agents; Condition history (e.g., active VTE for hormonal contraindication, GI bleed for NSAID); explicit clinician note that trial is contraindicated.

verdict_rubric.met: Specific contraindication to hormonal or NSAID therapy explicitly documented.
verdict_rubric.not_met: No contraindication documented and trial requirement applies.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Patient declined therapy citing 'side effects' without clinician note of contraindication.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No allergy, comorbidity, or clinician statement addressing contraindication.

children.description: If a cervix is present, cervical cytology must be non-malignant.
Nonmalignant cervical cytology documented if cervix is present (Pap NILM or benign within recommended interval).

policy_citation.quote: Nonmalignant cervical cytology, if cervix is present

evaluation.extraction_hints: Find Pap smear / liquid-based cervical cytology result. Acceptable: NILM, negative for intraepithelial lesion. If cervix absent (prior trachelectomy/supracervical hysterectomy), this criterion is automatically met.

verdict_rubric.met: Pap NILM/benign documented within standard screening interval; OR cervix documented as absent.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Pap shows HSIL, ASC-H, AGC, or other concerning finding.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Pap result documented but interpretation language ambiguous; OR no date specified.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No cervical cytology in records and cervix presence not addressed.

children.description: Negative preoperative pregnancy test OR documented postmenopausal status OR documented prior sterilization.

policy_citation.quote: Negative preoperative pregnancy test result unless patient is postmenopausal or has been previously sterilized

children.description: Negative preoperative pregnancy test (urine or serum hCG).

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for hCG result, urine or serum, with explicit 'negative' interpretation, dated within 14 days of planned surgery.

verdict_rubric.met: Negative hCG documented within 14 days of planned procedure.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Pregnancy test positive OR dated outside acceptable window.
verdict_rubric.unclear: hCG ordered but result pending; OR test date not clearly within window.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No pregnancy test in pre-op records.

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for explicit 'postmenopausal' in problem list, LMP >12 months ago, or FSH >25 IU/L with absent menses.

verdict_rubric.met: Postmenopausal status explicitly documented OR clear inference from LMP/FSH/age.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Patient has documented active menses or premenopausal status.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Age suggestive but menopausal status not addressed.

children.description: Patient has had a prior sterilization procedure.

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for surgical history of bilateral tubal ligation/Essure/salpingectomy.

verdict_rubric.met: Procedure history shows prior tubal ligation, salpingectomy, or equivalent.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Procedure history indicates no prior sterilization.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Patient reports 'tubes tied' but no procedure record available.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No surgical history reviewed or available.

exclusions.description: Hysterectomy for adenomyosis (N80.03) — covered by Section B criteria (6-month trial + imaging), not Section A. Routes to sibling policy oregon-hcr-39.

policy_citation.quote: Hysterectomy, with or without adnexectomy, for adenomyosis may be appropriate when all of the following are documented

evaluation.extraction_hints: If primary diagnosis is adenomyosis (N80.03), Section B criteria apply, not this policy's Section A path.

verdict_rubric.met: Primary diagnosis is adenomyosis (N80.03) — exclusion fires (re-route to Section B).
verdict_rubric.not_met: Endometriosis is documented as the primary indication.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Both adenomyosis and endometriosis documented; clarification needed on primary indication.

metadata.notes: Models Section A (endometriosis) of Oregon Guideline Note 39. Sibling of oregon-hcr-39 (Section B, adenomyosis). ICD-10 patterns intentionally exclude N80.03 so the selector routes adenomyosis cases to the sibling policy without ambiguity.
